corrections.why: The county list gives the Summit tower as 94 feet (about 28.7 m) in its text and table. The 100 feet in our record matches only a 1941 survey note that the PDF also prints under the LaSalle entry. Already reflected in facts; kept for human review of the record.

corrections.proposed: Minnesota Forest Service, now Minnesota DNR Forestry Division
corrections.why: 127N-37W-34 is a township-range-section location, not an agency. The county list records the owner as Mn MFS and footnotes it to the DNR Forestry Division. Already reflected in facts; kept for human review of the record.

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on the build year: the county list text says 1928, while the county table and the Central US page give 1938. They also disagree on height: 94 feet in the text and table, about 100 feet in a 1941 survey note. The 1941 note sits in the Summit row of the PDF, but the identical wording also sits in the LaSalle row, so its attribution to Summit is doubtful; the story says so. facts.height_m is 28.7 m (94 ft) per the text and table. The Central US page gives no height. No access, staffing or fire information was found.
